reference: Separate native reviewer extracts reference atoms and source/context fields before predictions; model references are not human gold.
prediction: Fresh native worker receives only cases and this protocol, not reference annotations or earlier predictions.
metrics: exact quote and local line alignment
atomic action precision/recall against provisional references
downstream checker after explicit manual acceptance
matching: Match atoms by source_id and canonical action. Compound source actions are split. All proposals must use exact supplied snippet quotes and local line 1. Context-derived scope is permitted but must be explained. Numerical semantics may be extracted as a soft candidate while noting that Boolean encoding does not prove typography.
limits: Six selected fragments with a supplied action vocabulary and context hints; easier than unrestricted full-policy extraction.
Source spans are held out from feasibility case texts, but source families overlap.
No human gold, no live provider API, no claim this native-worker path is integrated into the product.
A missing/review-only interpretation is not a clean verdict.
